root_cause: Provider health was probed only after mutating preparatory SQL, refreshing message plans, calling composer and validating unrelated AI model governance; failures in these steps left channel capability stale. dry_run also executed those preparations.
change: Run one independent read-only provider preflight before other work, persist real capability truth in the existing registry only for normal runs, and return a genuinely side-effect-free dry-run result before SQL/AI mutation.
prevention: No false green from an active Composio connector
Retain same canonical scheduler and recipient authorization controls
Never replace provider readback with an internal status
verification_required: true provider status readback, no sends
